description: Tests the ability of a user to navigate to and view the Privacy Policy from the login page.
steps: Navigate to the login page at https://dev.roost.ai/login.
Verify the presence of the Privacy Policy link in the footer.
Click on the Privacy Policy link.
Wait for the Privacy Policy page to load.
Verify that the page URL is https://roost.ai/privacy-policy.
Ensure the content of the Privacy Policy page is displayed correctly.
expected_results: User should be redirected to the Privacy Policy page.
Correct URL should be displayed in the browser.
edge_cases: Privacy Policy page fails to load due to server issues.
Link is not clickable due to rendering issues.
Incorrect content is displayed on the Privacy Policy page.
Network latency causes slow page load.
User is redirected to an incorrect URL.
data_requirements: Valid URL for the Privacy Policy page.
Footer element with Privacy Policy link.
Content for the Privacy Policy page.
dependencies: Privacy Policy page exists and is up-to-date.
User has access to the internet.
performance_metrics: Time taken to load the Privacy Policy page.
Latency for redirection to the Privacy Policy page.
accessibility_requirements: Ensure the Privacy Policy link has appropriate ARIA labels.
Verify keyboard navigation for the footer link.
Check the text contrast ratio on the Privacy Policy page.
